newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Novartis says deal good for Roche.
newsitem.headline: Novartis says deal good for Roche.

text.p: Novartis AG chief executive Daniel Vasella praised Roche's acquisition of Boehringer Mannheim group as a good move for Roche, but said it would have no impact on Novartis.
"It is a good move for Roche. It makes a lot of sense, especially for the diagnostic part of their business," Vasella told reporters at the Internatinal Management Symposium in St Gallen.
"I also believe from the point of view of the implantation business that it is quite a good business with the orthopaedics and so forth," he added.
He said he spoke with Roche's chief operating officer Franz Humer this morning and offered his congratulations.
"It does not have...any strategic importance (for Novartis) at all because we are not active in these two businesses," he added.
He said stronger competitors in principle gave Novartis incentive to improve its performance.
Novartis's strategy was unchanged, he said, adding it would continue to invest heavily in innovation, increase productivity, and build performance by investing in people.
